title: 触发器 BEFORE/AFTER 时序与 NEW/OLD 可用性（sqlite 实跑）
expected_output:
=== stock_log（由触发器按事件写入） ===
seq action  item  old_qty  new_qty 
1   INSERT  A1    NULL     10      
2   UPDATE  A1    10       99      
3   DELETE  A1    99       NULL    

=== BEFORE / AFTER 的时序差异（同一行 10 -> 99）===
  1. BEFORE-UPDATE  查表得到的 qty = 10
  2. AFTER-UPDATE   查表得到的 qty = 99
  BEFORE 触发器看到的仍是旧值 10（数据页还没写）
  AFTER  触发器看到的是新值 99（数据页已经写）

=== NEW / OLD 可用性矩阵 ===
事件       OLD      NEW     
INSERT   不可用      可用      
UPDATE   可用       可用      
DELETE   可用       不可用     
跨引擎差异: MySQL 的 BEFORE 触发器可用 SET NEW.col = ... 改写即将写入的行;
            sqlite 不支持该写法, 只能通过 AFTER 触发器再补一条 UPDATE 修正。
code:
import sqlite3

# sqlite 原生支持 CREATE TRIGGER 与伪记录 NEW / OLD, 语义与 MySQL 一致(除 MySQL 可改 NEW 外)
con = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
con.executescript("""
CREATE TABLE stock(item TEXT PRIMARY KEY, qty INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE stock_log(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                       action TEXT, item TEXT, old_qty INT, new_qty INT);
CREATE TABLE probe(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, phase TEXT, seen_qty INT);

-- AFTER INSERT: 只有 NEW 可用
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ai AFTER INSERT ON stock
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO stock_log(action,item,old_qty,new_qty)
  VALUES('INSERT', NEW.item, NULL, NEW.qty);
END;

-- BEFORE UPDATE: OLD 与 NEW 都可用; 此时数据页尚未写入
CREATE TRIGGER trg_bu BEFORE UPDATE ON stock
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO stock_log(action,item,old_qty,new_qty)
  VALUES('UPDATE', OLD.item, OLD.qty, NEW.qty);
  INSERT INTO probe(phase, seen_qty)
  VALUES('BEFORE-UPDATE', (SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE item = NEW.item));
END;

-- AFTER UPDATE: 数据页已写入
CREATE TRIGGER trg_au AFTER UPDATE ON stock
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO probe(phase, seen_qty)
  VALUES('AFTER-UPDATE', (SELECT qty FROM stock WHERE item = NEW.item));
END;

-- AFTER DELETE: 只有 OLD 可用
CREATE TRIGGER trg_ad AFTER DELETE ON stock
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO stock_log(action,item,old_qty,new_qty)
  VALUES('DELETE', OLD.item, OLD.qty, NULL);
END;
""")

con.execute("INSERT INTO stock VALUES('A1', 10)")
con.execute("UPDATE stock SET qty = 99 WHERE item = 'A1'")   # OLD=10, NEW=99
con.execute("DELETE FROM stock WHERE item = 'A1'")

print("=== stock_log（由触发器按事件写入） ===")
print("%-3s %-7s %-5s %-8s %-8s" % ("seq", "action", "item", "old_qty", "new_qty"))
for r in con.execute("SELECT seq, action, item, old_qty, new_qty FROM stock_log ORDER BY seq"):
    print("%-3s %-7s %-5s %-8s %-8s" % (r[0], r[1], r[2], "NULL" if r[3] is None else r[3],
                                        "NULL" if r[4] is None else r[4]))

print()
print("=== BEFORE / AFTER 的时序差异（同一行 10 -> 99）===")
for seq, phase, seen in con.execute("SELECT seq, phase, seen_qty FROM probe ORDER BY seq"):
    print("  %d. %-14s 查表得到的 qty = %s" % (seq, phase, seen))
print("  BEFORE 触发器看到的仍是旧值 10（数据页还没写）")
print("  AFTER  触发器看到的是新值 99（数据页已经写）")

print()
print("=== NEW / OLD 可用性矩阵 ===")
print("%-8s %-8s %-8s" % ("事件", "OLD", "NEW"))
print("%-8s %-8s %-8s" % ("INSERT", "不可用", "可用"))
print("%-8s %-8s %-8s" % ("UPDATE", "可用", "可用"))
print("%-8s %-8s %-8s" % ("DELETE", "可用", "不可用"))
print("跨引擎差异: MySQL 的 BEFORE 触发器可用 SET NEW.col = ... 改写即将写入的行;")
print("            sqlite 不支持该写法, 只能通过 AFTER 触发器再补一条 UPDATE 修正。")
